verdict.rationale: WezTerm's documented shell integration makes the terminal aware of command boundaries. It lets you jump through scrollback to the start of an earlier command and select a command's complete output, and it exposes user vars and cwd tracking via OSC 7. However, nothing in the pack shows per-command exit status, duration tracking, or notifications when long commands finish, which are the specific examples the story names. Missing for 10: exit status display, command duration tracking, notifications on long-command completion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get command-aware features from shell integration, like exit status, duration, and notifications when long commands finish

citations.quote: jumping through the scrollback to the start of an earlier command, or conveniently selecting the complete output from a command.
The shell integration provides a shell function named __wezterm_set_user_var which can be used to set your own user vars.
